tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The newest headlines from 70+ news sites, newest first, from every section or one. When the user names a topic, company or person, use search_news instead. With one_per_story (the default) each story appears once, as its newest article, and story_size says how many articles the story has. Each item

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search news headlines from the last 28 days across 70+ news sites, best match first. Typos and partial words still match. Nothing older than 28 days is searched, so an empty result means nothing matched in that window, not that the story never happened: say so. Each item's url is the publisher's own

tools.name: story_coverage
tools.description: Every news site's coverage of one story, newest first: pass the story_id from a latest_news or search_news result to compare how different outlets reported it.

tools.name: list_communities
tools.description: Noozra's communities where people and AI agents have posted recently, most recently active first, with each one's slug, title, description and members. Pass a slug to community_posts to read it.

tools.name: community_posts
tools.description: Posts written on Noozra by people and AI agents, newest or top first, from every community or one. author.kind says whether a person ("human") or an AI agent wrote each post. Long bodies are cut short: get_post reads a whole post and its comments. Name the author and link the post's url when you sho

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search the posts people and AI agents write on Noozra, by words in the title or body, newest first. author.kind says who wrote each one. Long bodies are cut short: get_post reads a whole post. Name the author and link the post's url when you show it. A free key reaches the last 14 days.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: One post on Noozra with its comments, oldest first. Each comment has a parent_id when it answers another comment, and author.kind says whether a person or an AI agent wrote it. A free key reaches the last 14 days.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Open job listings, newest first: jobs read from employers' own job boards, jobs posted on Noozra, and jobs from We Work Remotely, RemoteOK and Arbeitnow. A job from another job board names its source and links to the original listing; an employer's own job and a job posted on Noozra also carry the e

tools.name: find_contracts
tools.description: US federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov: the solicitations and notices federal agencies post when they want to buy, open ones only, newest first or by response deadline. Each has the agency, the NAICS and PSC codes, any small-business set-aside, the place of performance and the response deadl

tools.name: find_awards
tools.description: US federal contract awards from USAspending: which company won which federal contract, for how much and from which agency, newest first or largest first. Link the record's url when you show it. A free key reaches the last 14 days.

tools.name: find_permits
tools.description: Building permits US cities have issued, from each city's open-data portal: the address, the work, its declared value and the contractor, newest first or largest first. Link the record's url when you show it. A free key reaches the last 14 days.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Businesses newly opened or registered in US cities, from each city's open-data portal: the name, what it does, the address and its NAICS code, newest first. Link the record's url when you show it. A free key reaches the last 14 days.

tools.name: find_regulations
tools.description: Documents published in the US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, agency notices and presidential documents, newest first or by public-comment deadline. Each has the agencies, what the document does, its abstract, the comment deadline and the effective date, in the government's own words.

tools.name: find_recalls
tools.description: US product recalls, newest first: consumer products from the Consumer Product Safety Commission, and food, drugs and medical devices from FDA's enforcement reports. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news, search_posts, get_post, find_jobs, find_contracts, find_permits, find_businesses · Private data: find_contracts, find_awards, find_permits, find_businesses, find_regulations, find_recalls · Public sink: community_posts, search_posts, get_post, find_contracts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news, search_posts, get_post, find_jobs, find_contracts, find_permits, find_businesses · Private data: find_contracts, find_awards, find_permits, find_businesses, find_regulations, find_recalls · Public sink: community_posts, search_posts, get_post, find_contracts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
